changelog:
Initial release with logical condition tree, union-find, and XML I/O utilities.

- Adds ConditionTree for building and managing logical condition trees.
- Implements UnionFind for efficient set management, including union and find operations.
- Provides XmlIO for XML file reading/writing, supporting ConditionTree serialization.
- Includes example usages and API documentation for all components.
summary: Data structure toolkit for logical condition trees, union-find operations, and XML file I/O. Use when working with tree-based data structures, set operations...
